response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT s.instownpct, t.ordertypedist FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL), benchmarks AS (SELECT instownpct, AVG(instownpct) OVER () AS overall_avg, AVG(instownpct) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS mix_avg FROM matched) SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership, AVG(instownpct / NULLIF(mix_avg, 0)) AS avg_ratio_to_mix, AVG(instownpct - overall_avg) AS avg_excess_overall FROM benchmarks WHERE instownpct > overall_avg
